name: shop-api
description: A small online shop backend (orders, payments, inventory, shipping, users; 28 files). Each task lists the files a developer would need to touch or read. Tasks 11 and 12 deliberately use different words than the code (reimburse, expire) to separate keyword search from embeddings.

cases.task: Send the customer an email with their receipt as soon as the payment goes through
Add partial refunds so support can return part of an order's money without cancelling the order
Screen orders for fraud using the shipping country as well as the order value before the card is charged
Automatically reorder products from the supplier when stock gets low
Reject orders for product codes that do not follow our SKU format
Check the postal code of the delivery address before we create a shipment
Show customers the delivery options from each carrier and let them pick the fastest one
Print shipping labels as PDF instead of the printer language
Require a second verification step when an admin signs in
Let staff see all orders in a given state, such as paid or shipped
Reimburse a customer when the warehouse cannot fulfil part of their order
Make passwords expire after ninety days and force a change at the next login
Let customers follow their parcel and see when it was delivered
Stop selling a product when every warehouse is out of stock
